ostheer.name: Blitzkrieg Doctrine
ostheer.why: Breakthrough vehicles and smoke support maps with long approaches. Good default when you want tempo through mid fuel.

ostheer.name: Jaeger Infantry Doctrine
ostheer.why: Light infantry tools and AT options for green/cover maps. Helps when early MG wars decide VPs.

ostheer.name: Festung Armor Doctrine
ostheer.why: Defensive armor and holds. Pick when the map rewards locking a fuel and refusing a messy mid scrap.

ostheer.name: Elite Troops Doctrine
ostheer.why: Quality infantry spikes. Useful on dense cover maps where gren upgrades and assault infantry trade well.

ostheer.name: Strategic Reserves Doctrine
ostheer.why: Call-in flexibility when the game goes long and you need an answer piece without full tech dedication.

soviet.name: Guard Rifle Combined Arms
soviet.why: Guards + AT package covers the classic Soviet mid spike. Reliable when fuel is contested.

soviet.name: Lend Lease Tactics
soviet.why: Allied vehicles and support fill holes in soft AT / recon. Strong generalist pick.

soviet.name: Counterattack Tactics
soviet.why: Tempo tools after you absorb an early push. Good on maps with a clear reset lane to a VP.

soviet.name: Shock Rifle Frontline
soviet.why: Shock infantry pressure for urban / trench-style maps where bodies on VPs matter.

soviet.name: Tank Hunters Tactics
soviet.why: Extra AT depth when you expect enemy armor to decide the late game.

okw.name: Breakthrough Doctrine
okw.why: Aggressive battlegroup tools and armor timing. Default when you can secure an early fuel.

okw.name: Fortifications Doctrine
okw.why: Holds and defensive infra. Fits maps where you seed a HQ and refuse to overextend.

okw.name: Elite Armored Doctrine
okw.why: Late armor quality. Pick when the map tends to go long around dual fuels.

okw.name: Luftwaffe Ground Forces
okw.why: AA/air-ground mix and flexible support. Useful when light vehicles and loiters clutter mid.

okw.name: Special Operations Doctrine
okw.why: Harassment and specialty infantry. Good for flank-heavy woodland maps.

usf.name: Infantry Company
usf.why: Riflemen upgrades and infantry answers. Solid default on cover-heavy 1v1s.

usf.name: Armor Company
usf.why: Armor spike and medium pressure. Take when fuels are reachable and you want a clean mid.

usf.name: Mechanized Company
usf.why: Halftracks and mobile combined arms for open approaches.

usf.name: Airborne Company
usf.why: Paratroop and flank pressure. Strong on maps with rear VP paths or isolated fuels.

usf.name: Rifle Company
usf.why: Straightforward rifle path when you want fewer moving parts and steady tech.

ukf.name: Royal Engineer Regiment
ukf.why: Emplacements and utility. Excellent generalist for holding fuels and cutting lanes.

ukf.name: Advanced Emplacement Company
ukf.why: Hardpoints and defensive mid. Fits maps where a 6-pdr / emplacement line wins the choke.

ukf.name: Commando Company
ukf.why: Flank infantry and raids. Good when the minimap shows long green edges.

ukf.name: Royal Artillery Support
ukf.why: Map control via barrages when VPs sit behind cover you cannot comfortably walk.

ukf.name: Weapons Company Tactics
ukf.why: Crewed weapons focus. Helps stabilize early MG/mortar wars.
